intro: Filter by field name, label, or text. Kind badges: Exact = logged as recorded; Heuristic = derived estimate; Legacy = kept for compatibility, not populated on new rows.

entries.label: When the row was written
entries.explanation: Server wall-clock time when this log row was appended (ISO-8601 local, seconds precision).

entries.label: Participant ID
entries.explanation: Stable study ID (e.g. P001). Normalised to P + three digits when possible.

entries.label: Stable row UUID
entries.explanation: UUID v4 linking the CSV row to optional JSON sidecars under data/edit_traces/<participant_id>/.

entries.label: Relative path to edit trace JSON
entries.explanation: Repo-relative POSIX path from the prototype root, e.g. data/edit_traces/P001/<uuid>.json. Empty when no sidecar was written.

entries.label: UI lane
entries.explanation: SMS, Messenger, Email, or Voice (pure audio lane).

entries.label: How the participant composed text
entries.explanation: Typing, Swipe typing, Voice-to-text, Speech (pure Voice), or LLM for assistant rows.

entries.label: participant_reply vs system_generated
entries.explanation: Distinguishes human rows from generated assistant rows.

entries.label: Response time (seconds)
entries.explanation: Wall time from the relevant prompt (or Alex follow-up) being shown until Send. See About → Metrics for first vs final reply anchoring.
entries.caveats: Not comparable to LLM latency on the same thread; assistant rows may log model timing separately.

entries.label: Words per minute
entries.explanation: (word count / response_time_seconds) × 60 using the same window as response_time_seconds.
entries.caveats: Uses the logged analysis text length; for Voice medium prefers transcript. Not a typing-speed measure for swipe or voice-to-text.

entries.label: Keystrokes (raw) / Keystrokes (study)
entries.explanation: Count of keydown events on the compose textarea. Study export renames this column to keystrokes for readability.
entries.caveats: Includes Shift, Enter, punctuation, etc. Swipe and mobile IME events are approximate. Voice-to-text: counts manual edits only, not speech production.

entries.label: Backspaces (raw) / Backspaces (study)
entries.explanation: keydown where key === 'Backspace'. Study export column: backspaces.

entries.label: Paste used
entries.explanation: yes/no if a paste event was observed on the compose field during that reply.

entries.label: Browser autocomplete / IME correction
entries.explanation: yes/no when the in-app suggestion chip was applied (not general rewriting). Study export: browser_autocomplete.

entries.label: Manual edit count (heuristic)
entries.explanation: backspace_count + (1 if paste) + (1 if correction_applied).
entries.caveats: Not a full edit-diff; do not treat as ground-truth revision depth.

entries.label: KSPC
entries.explanation: keypress_count / len(reply_text) for non-LLM rows.
entries.caveats: Input-method-specific; do not compare typing vs swipe vs voice-to-text.

entries.label: Backspaces per word
entries.explanation: backspace_count divided by word count of reply_text when words > 0.

entries.label: Edit ratio
entries.explanation: manual_edit_count / character length of reply_text.

entries.label: Edit activity compact code
entries.explanation: Short token summarising B/P/A counts (backspace, paste, autocomplete), e.g. B1P0A0.

entries.label: Whether a JSON sidecar exists
entries.explanation: yes when a bounded trace file was written for this row; no for pure Voice rows, LLM rows, or when the client sent no trace.

entries.label: Revision estimate
entries.explanation: Client-derived count of meaningful text-change steps (threshold on insert/delete deltas).
entries.caveats: Not a true revision count; free text has no gold target.

entries.label: Inserted / deleted characters (est.)
entries.explanation: Cumulative sum of greedy per-step insert/delete deltas recorded on the active compose field during the session (value_diff + finalize_align). Measures edit churn and revision work, not unique keystrokes.
entries.caveats: Often exceeds net message length because edits overlap (e.g. replace, IME, corrections). Not a copy-typing error rate. Client finalize only reconciles the medium that sent the row (SMS / Messenger / Email), not inactive textareas.

entries.label: Net character change
entries.explanation: len(final_sent_text) − len(initial_empty_session) for the compose session.

entries.label: Manual edits after transcript (est.)
entries.explanation: Greedy insert+delete distance between the first inserted voice transcript string in that trace session and the final sent text.
entries.caveats: Uses the first non-empty transcript anchor only; a second dictation pass does not replace that anchor (see sidecar disclaimers). Zero when input method is not voice-to-text or no transcript marker.

entries.label: Voice transcript initial length
entries.explanation: Character length of the transcript when it was first inserted into the box (Voice-to-text).

entries.label: Voice transcript fingerprint (sidecar)
entries.explanation: Length + hash + short prefix of the first non-empty transcript string captured in that trace session (not the live textarea after edits).
entries.caveats: Paired with manual_edit_chars_after_transcript_est; re-dictation does not replace this anchor.

entries.label: Sidecar layer sizes (schema ≥ 2)
entries.explanation: Counts of recorded items in each bounded array at finalize time (for quick QA without scanning arrays).
entries.caveats: Not written to CSV; JSON sidecar only.

entries.label: Edit trace schema version
entries.explanation: 1 = legacy single `events` array; 2 = three layers `key_events`, `text_mutations`, `snapshots` (value fingerprints). Readers should accept both.

entries.label: Key / interaction events (schema ≥ 2)
entries.explanation: Bounded list of keydown/keyup plus paste/cut (length-only for paste) and synthetic `send` after SMS/Messenger Enter-submit. Includes modifier booleans and selection indices when readable. Not a full keylogger: hard cap and no clipboard body.
entries.caveats: Swipe/IME/mobile: sparse or batched vs physical typing.

entries.label: Text mutation events (schema ≥ 2)
entries.explanation: DOM-level signals: beforeinput/input summaries (inputType, data_len), value_diff (rough ins/del/len per change), composition*, voice_transcript_insert (marker only), suggestion_autocomplete_apply, finalize_align. Optional data_char only when insertText length is exactly 1 (linkage, not content logging).
entries.caveats: Voice transcript insert is explicit; subsequent value_diff entries are manual edits unless another layer applies.

entries.label: Value fingerprints / snapshots
entries.explanation: Throttled length/hash/prefix samples of the compose value after substantive edits (same role in v1 and v2).
entries.caveats: Prefix is bounded; not a full replay log.

entries.label: Legacy unified trace events (schema 1)
entries.explanation: schema_version 1 only: mixed session, text_change, keydown_special, etc. v2 traces omit this array.
entries.caveats: Prefer three-layer fields for new analysis.

entries.label: Study-language disclaimers
entries.explanation: Static strings clarifying that metrics describe edit behaviour, not copy-typing error rate, and caveats for voice/swipe.

entries.label: Prompt shown for this row
entries.explanation: The scenario text the participant answered for this event.

entries.label: Reply text / participant copy
entries.explanation: reply_text is always the message for the row. participant_reply_text duplicates it on human rows; study export uses participant_reply_text as the main human column.

entries.label: Second-turn participant reply
entries.explanation: Filled only on the participant’s final reply in a two-turn SMS/Messenger run; empty elsewhere.

entries.label: Assistant-generated text
entries.explanation: The assistant message on LLM rows; empty on normal participant rows.

entries.label: Speech-to-text transcript
entries.explanation: For Voice-to-text: initial ASR text sent alongside the final edited reply_text. For pure Voice: recognised speech when available.
entries.caveats: Final edited compose text lives in reply_text; compare to transcript for manual changes.

entries.label: Transcript pipeline metadata
entries.explanation: Client/server bookkeeping for how transcript was obtained (e.g. upload_api).

entries.label: Uploaded reply audio file
entries.explanation: Filename under static/audio for voice replies; used for playback in admin.

entries.label: Model label (raw) / Register (study)
entries.explanation: Output of the trained formality classifier (e.g. LABEL_0 / LABEL_1). Study base column reply_register is a human-readable map (Informal/Formal). Advanced study column formality_model_label_raw keeps the raw code.

entries.label: Model confidence
entries.explanation: Classifier score from the formality service.

entries.label: Register (human label, admin only)
entries.explanation: Server-rendered friendly label (Formal / Informal) from raw formality_label. Not written to CSV.

entries.label: Prompt–reply register match
entries.explanation: yes/no coarse match between prompt and reply formality labels (neutral matches either).

entries.label: Rule-based style hints
entries.explanation: Legacy heuristics on top of model labels; use formality_label for primary analysis.

entries.label: Analysis availability / which text was analysed
entries.explanation: Whether NLP ran and whether reply_text vs transcript was used as input.

entries.label: Logged prompt condition
entries.explanation: formal, informal, or auto:… from bundle/admin. Study export column prompt_condition is a short readable form.

entries.label: Optional tone tags
entries.explanation: Optional researcher tags; not back-filled from heuristics.

entries.label: LLM provider string
entries.explanation: openai, fallback, client_error, etc. on assistant rows.

entries.label: BERT / star-sentiment columns (legacy)
entries.explanation: Columns retained for backward compatibility. New rows leave them blank; they previously held an unrelated HuggingFace star-rating sentiment demo.
entries.caveats: Not Jakob’s formality model. Do not use for current study analysis.

entries.label: Per-run exports
entries.explanation: Separate from the main sentiment_log_web.csv — one row per completed two-turn task under prototype/data/runs/. Different column schema.
entries.caveats: Not listed field-for-field here; see run export headers in logging_utils._run_csv_headers.

entries.label: Simplified study CSV
entries.explanation: Human rows only; readable column names; optional advanced columns. Never embeds full edit_trace JSON.
